categorisation: This gazette contains multiple notices under Section 33 of the Land Acquisition Act regarding compensation deposits for acquired lands. The content specifically deals with land acquisition matters, including detailed descriptions of land parcels (lot numbers, extents, locations), compensation amounts, and legal procedures for land acquisition. This fits the definition of Type 4 (Land Gazettes) which covers "land acquisitions, transfers, or disposals" and "any gazette content primarily dealing with land, property, or real estate matters."
